name: window_start
description: Candle open time = start of the 1-minute window (inclusive, UTC). Partition column.

name: trade_count
description: Number of trades in the candle, as reported by Binance.

name: quote_volume
description: Quote asset volume (sum of price * quantity).

name: vwap
description: Volume weighted average price: quote_volume / volume. NULL for a candle without volume.

name: open
description: Price of the first trade in the candle.

name: close
description: Price of the last trade in the candle.

name: buy_volume
description: Taker-buy base volume (aggressor was the buyer).

name: source
description: Where the row came from, e.g. binance_klines.

name: loaded_ts
description: When the backfill job loaded this row.
